title: For Raoul. Eat. If I net five guineas with those ads. The violet silk petticoats. Not yet. The sweets of sin.
html_source:
The sirens of eroticism are calling in Bloom’s mind. Ms. Douce and Ms. Kennedy do not sing when Bloom has dinner in the Ormonde.

In Lestrygonians, Bloom came up with the idea of buying the petticoats.
